symptoms.symptom: Freezer door/drawer pops open when refrigerator door is closed

causes.label: This is normal if, after popping open, the freezer door/drawer closed on its own.
remedies: This indicates that there is a good seal on the freezer door/drawer.
If the freezer door/drawer does not automatically close after popping open, then see the Problem: Door/drawer does not close by itself, above.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "This is normal if, after popping open, the freezer door/drawer closed on its own."

symptoms.symptom: Icemaker power switch is in the I (on) position, but green power light is not on

causes.label: Freezer door/drawer is open.
remedies: This is normal.
Power to the icemaker is interrupted when the freezer door/drawer is open to prevent ice from ejecting and dropping into the back of the freezer.
To check if icemaker is working properly, press the freezer light switch located on the upper right side of the freezer.
The green power light will come on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Freezer door/drawer is open."

symptoms.symptom: Water is spilling out of icemaker mold

causes.label: Freezer door/drawer was opened shortly after icemaker was installed.
remedies: Clean up spill, then shut the freezer door/drawer and do not open for approximately 4 hours.
This will allow the freezer to reach the correct operating temperature for making ice.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Freezer door/drawer was opened shortly after icemaker was installed."

causes.label: Freezer door left open for an extended period, then opened and closed frequently soon after.
remedies: Because of door openings, freezer could not maintain the correct operating temperature for making ice.
Clean up spill, then shut the freezer door/drawer and do not open for approximately 4 hours.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Freezer door left open for an extended period, then opened and closed frequently soon after."

symptoms.symptom: Cubes too small/ reduced ice production

causes.label: Not enough water pressure to icemaker water valve.
remedies: Collar type self-piercing water valves are not recommended unless a 1/4″ hole is predrilled in home water line.
See Installing the Water Line instructions in the Icemaker Accessory Kit Installation Instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Not enough water pressure to icemaker water valve."
